scripts.build: bun run build:plugin && bun run build:cli && bun run build:web
scripts.build:cli: bun build cli/index.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun && bun -e "const f=require('fs');const c=f.readFileSync('dist/cli.js','utf8');f.writeFileSync('dist/cli.js','#!/usr/bin/env bun\n'+c)"
scripts.build:web: cd web && bun run build && cp -r dist ../dist/web
scripts.dev: bun run build && echo 'Built to dist/'
